First quarter FY27 sales grew 10.1% year-on-year to ₹151,836 million, driven by 16% growth in Indian formulations.

Management guided for high single-digit top line growth in FY27. In Q1 FY27, sales grew 10.1% year-on-year to ₹151,836 million, exceeding expectations, while EBITDA margin landed at 28.9% and R&D spend reached 5.4% of sales.

Management did not provide explicit forward-looking guidance numbers for revenue or margins for Q2 FY27. However, they expressed an aspirational goal of reaching 16% to 17% EBIT margins over time. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, reported revenue was ₹4,663.9 crore (up 30.3% YoY) and EBIT margin was 15%.

Management stated that core infrastructure net external debt is around INR 45,000 crores, backed by a regulatory asset base under $4 billion. For metals, materials, and mining, net external debt is about $2 billion against $6 billion in operating assets. Core infra leverage is guided to remain in the 3.5x to 4.5x range (at 3.9x currently), with conservative leverage kept for mining.
